lastResponse.text: First step: call nine one one right now for emergency help and a ride for insulin. Call 9, 1, 1. I’ll repeat: 9, 1, 1. Tell the dispatcher: “I am shaky and nauseous, I use insulin, I have no bus fare, and my phone battery is at three percent.” If the call drops, dial 9, 1, 1 again immediately.
